#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ull = unsigned long long;

const int MAXN = 250010;

int n, k, p, lim;
int pc[MAXN];
ull dp[26][MAXN], fact[MAXN], invfact[MAXN], powv, total;

ull mod_pow(ull base, int expo) {
    ull res = 1;
    while (expo > 0) {
        if (expo & 1) res = res * base % p;
        base = base * base % p;
        expo >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ull solve_dp(int K, int N) {
    if (pc[N] < K) return 0;
    if (K == 1) return dp[K][N] = invfact[N];
    if (dp[K][N]) return dp[K][N];

    ull cur = 0;
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int sub = N & (N - 1); sub; sub = N & (sub - 1)) {
        if (pc[sub] >= K - 1) {
            cur += solve_dp(K - 1, sub) * invfact[N ^ sub];
            if (++cnt == 18) {
                cnt = 0;
                cur %= p;
            }
        }
    }
    return dp[K][N] = cur % p;
}

ull comb(int N, int M) {
    return fact[N] * invfact[M] % p * invfact[N - M] % p;
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("255x.in", "r", stdin);
    freopen("255x.out", "w", stdout);
#endif
    if (scanf("%d%d%d", &n, &k, &p) != 3) return 0;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) pc[i] = pc[i >> 1] + (i & 1);

    powv = mod_pow(k, n);
    if (n & 1) {
        printf("%d\n", powv);
        return 0;
    }

    lim = min(k, pc[n]);

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;

    invfact[n] = mod_pow(fact[n], p - 2);
    for (int i = n; i >= 1; --i) invfact[i - 1] = invfact[i] * i % p;

    total = 0;
    for (int i = lim; i >= 1; --i) total += comb(k, i) * solve_dp(i, n);

    ull ans = (powv - total % p * fact[n] % p + p) % p;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
